edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the Owned constructor.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller supplied token amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the new pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and then resets it to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
DJC constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
DJC constructor sets symbol = 'DJC'.
DJC constructor sets name = 'DJ Coin'.
DJC constructor sets decimals = 18.
DJC constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the hardcoded holder address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer updates balances for both the sender and the recipient.
approve writes the nested allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
safeAdd performs the raw uint addition a + b that is only guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs the raw uint subtraction a - b that is only guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw uint multiplication a * b that is checked afterwards with c / a == b.
safeDiv performs the raw uint division a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
totalSupply performs an unguarded uint subtraction instead of delegating to safeSub.
approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval while its own state is already written.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract chosen by the owner.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances[from] and for the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for balances[to].
